title: Spicy Eastern Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with eastern noodles, kicked sauce, and peppery vegetables.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the carrots and bell peppers and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add the cucumber and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the kicked sauce and middle eastern spice blend.
Return the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the noodles are well coated.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
